# Newsletter signup designs (fixture, text description of 6 frames)

1. "Footer - default": email field labeled "Email", button "Subscribe".
2. "Footer - error": same, red border, text under field "Enter a valid email address".
3. "Footer - loading": button shows spinner, button disabled, email field read-only.
4. "Footer - success": field replaced with check icon and "You're subscribed. Check your inbox to confirm."
5. "Footer - already subscribed": info icon and "You're already subscribed."
6. "Footer - failed": text "Something went wrong" and button "Try again"; email field still shows the typed email.
